sources.name: Sewer-ML: Multi-Label Sewer Defect Benchmark & Research Dataset
sources.provider: Aalborg University (Visual Analysis of People Lab)
sources.license_text_reference: Authorized Sewer-ML research dataset access granted via AAU ScienceData repository.
sources.notes: Authorized Sewer-ML research access. GCS curated-v3 and curated-v4 each contain 20,000 SHA-256-unique and dHash-unique training records. Curated-v3 preserves the recorded 4,315 reused plus 15,685 extracted checkpoint; curated-v4 currently contains 4,726 reused plus 15,274 extracted records after revised curation. The v4 held-out splits contain 819 early-stop, 380 threshold-tuning, and 388 development-report images. Models trained under this noncommercial license remain research candidates with production_approved=false.

sources.name: SRuibo/Sewer-pipe-defects
sources.license_text_reference: Hugging Face dataset card declares license: cc-by-4.0.
sources.notes: Imported to immutable GCS quarantine from source revision 7fafcbe676aad60f38d8fe39cde93cf599f8362e. Registry contains paired YOLO images/labels: train 1,561, val 193, test 198. Deduplication against Sewer-ML v4 found 357 exact SHA-256 matches, 144 near-dHash matches, and 1,451 unique candidates; five exact duplicates also exist within the 1,952 SRuibo records. Original classes are CK, PL, SG, SL, TL, and ZW. Class semantics and primary provenance are not documented in the dataset card, so all records remain quarantined and mappings fail closed to GEOMETRY_UNCERTAIN until verified.

sources.name: Robotic Pipe Defect Detection
sources.license_text_reference: Roboflow project API declares license: CC BY 4.0.
sources.notes: Version 7 YOLOv8 export is preserved in GCS quarantine with 1,917 records (1,728 train, 126 validation, 63 test). Strict cross-source and intra-source perceptual deduplication leaves 333 unique candidates; 1 is an exact dHash match to the baseline, 445 are exact intra-source dHash duplicates, and 1,138 are near duplicates. Original Deformation, Misalignment, Obstacle, and Rupture labels are retained and mapped to JointInspect canonical labels. Keep quarantined until annotation and primary provenance review completes.
